name: obsidian
when_to_use: When writing notes under local/, link related notes with [[note-name]] and never edit .obsidian/. Vault is local/, never the repo root.

context_cost.note: An enabled extension adds one startup line; the Obsidian app itself costs 0 tokens.

risks: Closed-source freeware app. Vault must be local/, not the repo root, or .obsidian/ gets tracked. Graph is sparse until [[links]] are added.
